{{Languages|Canada/Open data}}
Open data that can be used for OpenStreetMap in Canada: what each source is good for, and how
far work on it has got. Only Ontario is filled in so far; other provinces are welcome.

This page is generated from [https://github.com/skfd/ontario-osm-data-sources ontario-osm-data-sources]. Fix a row there. Edit here if you like, and say so on the talk page.

'''A row here is not permission to import.''' The licence verdict for every portal lives in [[Canada#Open Data]] and on the OSMF [https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/OGL_Canada_and_local_variants OGL Canada and local variants] page; the LWG column only cites it. Every import still needs a proposal, a community discussion and an [[Import/Catalogue]] entry.

== Use ==
{| class="wikitable" style="font-size:90%"
! Use !! means
|-
| Import || bulk upload after an import proposal ([[Import/Guidelines]])
|-
| Conflate || merge names, attributes or missing features into what OSM already has
|-
| Validate || a gap list or task queue (gaps page, MapRoulette, Osmose) worked by hand
|-
| Reference || a tile layer to trace or check against; nothing is uploaded
|-
| No || not useful for OSM, or not licensed
|}

=== Address points ===
